title: Bernoulli subset expectation
statement: For a real number $p$ and a function $f$ from subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$, the Bernoulli subset expectation is $\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}p^{|S|}(1-p)^{n-|S|}f(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$
